slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Skills describe the workflow. Tools do the repeated work.
slides.subtitle: A practical mental model for coding agents.

slides.title: A skill can be markdown
slides.body: It tells the agent when to use a file-system pipeline, a REST API pipeline, debugging steps, or data validation steps.

slides.title: A tool is executable
slides.body: It reads files, counts rows, queries tables, runs pipelines, and inspects schemas through deterministic code.

slides.title: Why this matters
slides.body: The model can plan and choose the right workflow. Reusable code handles the operations that should not be invented every time.

slides.title: In the workshop
slides.body: The dlt workbench routed the agent to the right pipeline toolkit, then tools handled reading, loading, debugging, and validation.

slides.supportingText: A concrete example of skills and tools in an AI engineering workflow.
